label: For "Identity Threat Detection in SSO Logs": Detect token theft, MFA fatigue attacks and suspicious sign-ins in identity-provider logs in real time and trigger step-up or session revocation. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Labels from confirmed incidents only.
